copy.om: Mezgeb: Jecha iccitii haaromsuuf gaaffiin dhiyaateera. Imeelii keessan ilaalaa.

copy.en: Mezgeb: Your password changed. If this wasn't you, open Mezgeb and review account security.

copy.en: Mezgeb: A new sign-in was detected. If unexpected, review account security.
copy.am: መዝገብ፦ አዲስ መግቢያ ተመዝግቧል። ካላወቁ መለያዎን ይገምግሙ።
copy.om: Mezgeb: Seensi haaraan galmaa'eera. Yoo hin eegne nageenya herregaa ilaalaa.

copy.en: Mezgeb: Time to back up your business records. Open Settings > Data & backup.
copy.am: መዝገብ፦ መዝገቦችዎን ምትኬ ያስቀምጡ። ቅንብሮችን ይክፈቱ።
copy.om: Mezgeb: Galmee keessan kuusaa. Qindaa'ina banaa.

copy.en: Mezgeb: Your records need a sync review. Open Mezgeb Settings to check.
copy.am: መዝገብ፦ መዝገቦችዎ የማመሳሰል ግምገማ ይፈልጋሉ። ቅንብሮችን ይክፈቱ።
copy.om: Mezgeb: Galmeen keessan gamaaggama wal-simsiisaa barbaada. Qindaa'ina banaa.

copy.en: Mezgeb: You have a business reminder. Open Mezgeb to review it.
copy.am: መዝገብ፦ የንግድ ማስታወሻ አለዎት። መዝገብን ይክፈቱ።
copy.om: Mezgeb: Yaadachiisa daldalaa qabdu. Mezgeb banaa.

copy.en: Mezgeb: An update is available. Open Settings > App updates to check.
copy.am: መዝገብ፦ አዲስ ዝመና አለ። ቅንብሮች ውስጥ ዝመናዎችን ይፈልጉ።
copy.om: Mezgeb: Haaromsi jira. Qindaa'ina appii keessatti ilaalaa.
